notes: PLACEHOLDER rig file for the ROSbot XL + ZED 2i + RPLIDAR S3 rig (PLAN.md Sec 0). No metrology for this rig has been recorded yet: delta_z_m, delta_z_tolerance_m, board_standoff_m, pitch_deg and roll_deg are zeroed and every delta_z_chain term is a placeholder (placeholder=true). Replace every value with measured values (PLAN.md Sec 3) before using this file for anything beyond development diagnostics. Sign convention (PLAN.md Sec 1.2): delta_z_m is the height of the LiDAR scan plane above the rectified left camera optical centre in frame R, positive = LiDAR higher than camera. rig.load_rig() refuses (raises RuntimeError) to load this file unless the caller explicitly passes allow_placeholder=True, and any such call must print a loud warning banner (see rig.warn_if_placeholder).
